Two inline forms are available in any sentence: `literal` sets a machine
literal in the mono face, and [label](href) is a link. A clause cannot
carry a link, because the whole row is already one.
History goes in the sentence, never in a column. A status column cannot
carry a fact like 'it went through all three stages' honestly, and this
page shows no state at all.

page.title: Builds
page.description: Every project this design pipeline has built, one entry per brief, with its documents and their paths.
page.lede: Everything this pipeline has built, one entry per brief, most recently written first. Nothing on this page is live. Where a project has got to is in the console, at [`127.0.0.1:8790`](http://127.0.0.1:8790/).

agent-console.name: Front End Agents
agent-console.gloss: The console this pipeline reports into. It reads the pipeline's state file and writes your answers back. Opened from here it has no server behind it, so it shows sample data.

agent-console-check/.name: Drawing checks

tool-library.name: Fifth Street Tool Library
tool-library.gloss: A one page site for a neighborhood tool lending library. Built to give the console a real brief to carry, and it went through all three stages.

work-index.name: This page
work-index.gloss: The register you are reading. Its brief was to replace the server's own directory listing, which named six directories and said what none of them were.
